extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Saving XLSX files rewrites the entire workbook, potentially losing charts, images, and pivot caches. DOCX/PPTX editing is text-level only, and formatting changes are not supported.
problem: The inability to work with proprietary Microsoft Office files directly within the Obsidian environment.

relations.evidence: Part of the Materin plugin series (sibling plugins: materin-ctx, materin-view).
Part of the Materin plugin series (sibling plugins: materin-ctx, materin-view).

summary: Office file reader and editor that enables reading, editing, and saving formats like docx, xlsx, and pptx inside Obsidian.
